functions.name: publicCondition
functions.input: stored DCP row condition text from the structured-controls API
functions.output: the condition without our extraction note, or null
functions.if_none: null or note-only text returns null and no condition is shown

functions.name: row_fits_lot
functions.input: one captured assessment page with its API calls
functions.output: C4 flags for rows that do not fit this lot or project
functions.if_none: no DCP rows means nothing is examined

break_it.scenario: a real terrace row is phrased 'except dwelling houses, terraces 50%'
break_it.what_happens: the check would skip a row that is really for terraces
break_it.how: exclusion stops at the next full stop or semicolon; accepted, test keeps the plain terrace row red

break_it.scenario: the note appears mid-condition, not at the end
break_it.what_happens: council words after the note would be cut
break_it.how: the extraction always appends the note at the end; cut is from the marker to the end

break_it.scenario: note text reaches another surface (PDF report)
break_it.what_happens: readers of that surface still see it
break_it.how: C5 now flags it on the assessment page; other surfaces not covered here
break_it.repro: grep 'NOT yet stored' in a generated report
